heading: Interstate transfer of water from Arkansas
lead: No funds authorized to be appropriated by sections 390g to 390g–8 of this title shall be used for any activities associated with:

tree.text: the interstate transfer of water from the State of Arkansas; or
the study or demonstration of the potential for the interstate transfer of water from the State of Arkansas.
